# on_the_money.js

> Opinionated, attribute-driven, standards-oriented modern browser anti-framework. The server renders real semantic HTML (from any Markdown, structured-data, or template engine) and the browser enhances it with native APIs, DOM attribute state, a 5-S classless CSS cascade, and zero virtual DOM or client-side hydration.

## Authoring Context

- [README.md](README.md): Complete single-file authoring context — core API (`on`, `the`, `_t`, `route`, `$`, `$$`), batteries (`on_the_money/live`, `on_the_money/clipboard`, `on_the_money/combobox`), 5-S CSS substrate (`on_the_money/css`), lint stack (`otm-lint`, ESLint, Stylelint), and zero-config `otm-build`.
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md): Release history, contract changes, and migration notes.

## Public Type Contracts

- [src/core/index.d.ts](src/core/index.d.ts): Core runtime exports (`on`, `the`, `_t`, `route`, `$`, `$$`).
- [src/live/index.d.ts](src/live/index.d.ts): WebSocket (`live`) and Server-Sent Events (`sse`) battery contracts.
- [src/clipboard/index.d.ts](src/clipboard/index.d.ts): Capability-gated clipboard copy affordance contract.
- [src/combobox/index.d.ts](src/combobox/index.d.ts): WAI-ARIA APG combobox subpath battery contract.
- [src/test/index.d.ts](src/test/index.d.ts): `setupDOM` linkedom test harness contract.

## CSS Substrate (5-S Cascade)

- [src/css/index.css](src/css/index.css): Default classless entry (`@layer schema` + `azure` scheme).
- [src/css/schema.css](src/css/schema.css): Evergreen zero-class semantic HTML + ARIA foundation (`light-dark()`, `oklch` `color-mix()`, logical properties).
